caption: Title screen: Palmera Bay at golden hour, the camera looking down the main avenue.
On foot in Old Town: HUD, minimap with the mission marker, objective bar and the traffic of a living city.
Behind the wheel of a Comet GT on the beach road, two stars, a PBPD Interceptor in pursuit, the sea to the east.
The Big Score: the win screen after robbing the Palmera Bank and escaping to the hideout.
